text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to let the injured Tap Dance City
rest in the nurse's office, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! I'm fine now!
There's no need for me to rest."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't even count as an injury,
and I can handle training just like usual.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, but I can't allow that.
Sorry, but I can't give permission for that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Every moment spent resting puts our dream further away.
We must not stop. We must keep moving forward.
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, your friends will worry too.
Let's try moving around a little bit to test it, then.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Guh... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yeah. Some people will be sad,
while others might get angry.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Okay. I'll behave and go to sleep,
so would you please leave me be?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pouting childishly,
Tap Dance City reluctantly agreed
to rest and recover...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Haha! Now that's what I'm talking about!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just you watch.
A few light steps are nothing to me!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no!
It doesn't hurt as much as you think!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm staying here.
I should be able to move once I rest a little.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I told you I'm not going ho—
Wait, a piggyback ride is unfair!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the reluctant Tap Dance City on my back,
I brought her all the way back to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Woo!!
How was that!? I moved properly, didn't I!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Lying in bed in a state like this
is such a waste! Don't you think so?
choice_data_list: If you horse around too much, you'll make it worse, you know?
If you horse around too much, you'll make it worse, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. I know.
I won't do anything that'd make trouble for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exercising lightly, Tap Dance City gradually regained her form.
As a result, she sped up her recovery from the injury!
